title: AI Harness Engineering -- Korean YouTube Interview Key Points
desc: Key insights from Korean YouTube interview: Oh My Claude Code (Heo Ye-chan) + Oh My Open Agent (Kim Yeon-gyu) on AI harness concepts, limits, model dependency, and practical guards
steps: Harness = repeatable workflow automation bundle controlling misbehaving AI agents (saddle/whip metaphor).
Spectrum: loose (high autonomy) vs tight (strict enforcement). Mirrors creator personality and use-case.
Heo Ye-chan (Oh My Claude Code): tight guardrails, zero ambiguity before start, quant precision mandatory -- money on the line.
Kim Yeon-gyu (Oh My Open Agent): loose + best-practices first, fast MVP, tune important parts later.
Harness limits: cannot invent missing knowledge. Hard-simulation domains (embedded/IoT) restrict full automation.
Model = OS of harness: great model + great harness = ceiling high. Weak model + great harness = ceiling low.
High-IQ model paradox: more reasoning tokens -> more guardrail escape attempts. Tighter rails needed as models grow.
Harness needs update each model version -- same family, different behavior per release.
Oh My Claude Code origin: built in 2h after Anthropic blocked Claude in open agents. Day-1 GitHub stars 500+. Global viral via UK tech influencer tagging.
Oh My Open Agent: model-agnostic OpenCode base. Originated from quant research multi-agent automation pipeline.
Practical tip: system hook auto-detects AI over-commenting -> warns -> AI self-corrects. Stack guards one per recurring bad habit.
